initial_count_explanation: Only 12 seeds were supplied; all 12 passed. This was a preparation omission, not an eligibility limit. No target of 24 was encoded in tasks.json or the original code.
limitations: All sources are train and retrieval members, so questions are not independent final tests.
Family and lexical separation are verified; broad themes remain shared with gold (e.g. founder departure and enterprise sales).
Blog sources emphasize founder advice; they do not represent all media, claim types, or the author's corpus.
Source presence and manual relevance review do not prove retrieval recall or validate a future ontology.
Source-era numerical assertions require dates, attribution, and source spans in future work. No factual claims were newly scored.
